description: Screenshot of three consecutive tweets from Donald J. Trump (@realDonaldTrump), timestamped 35m, 46m and 59m ago. The first relays a message from Xi Jinping that Kim Jong Un's meeting with him went well and says maximum sanctions must be maintained; the second expresses optimism about denuclearization of the Korean Peninsula and a coming meeting with Kim Jong Un; the third declares the Second Amendment will never be repealed, referencing former Supreme Court Justice Stevens. Consistent with Trump's tweets of March 28, 2018.
text: Donald J. Trump @realDonaldTrump - 35m. Received message last night from XI JINPING of China that his meeting with KIM JONG UN went very well and that KIM looks forward to his meeting with me. In the meantime, and unfortunately, maximum sanctions and pressure must be maintained at all cost! 2.4K 3.6K 12K. Donald J. Trump @realDonaldTrump - 46m. For years and through many administrations, everyone said that peace and the denuclearization of the Korean Peninsula was not even a small possibility. Now there is a good chance that Kim Jong Un will do what is right for his people and for humanity. Look forward to our meeting! 2.9K 4.1K 15K. Donald J. Trump @realDonaldTrump - 59m. THE SECOND AMENDMENT WILL NEVER BE REPEALED! As much as Democrats would like to see this happen, and despite the words yesterday of former Supreme Court Justice Stevens, NO WAY. We need more Republicans in 2018 and must ALWAYS hold the Supreme Court!
flags: Date inferred from tweet content (March 28, 2018), not shown in screenshot

description: Meme about Beverly Eckert, a 9/11 widow and advocate whose husband Sean Rooney died in the World Trade Center. Left photo shows Eckert holding a photograph of her husband; right photo shows her shaking hands with President Barack Obama. First-person captions state she rejected a $1.8 million government settlement, filed a lawsuit instead, calls her a well-known figure in the 9/11 truth movement, and says she died in a plane crash days after meeting Obama — insinuating her death was not accidental. Eckert died in the crash of Colgan Air Flight 3407 near Buffalo on February 12, 2009; the meme's insinuation of foul play is unsupported. Watermarked thefreethoughtproject.com.
text: HI, I'M BEVERLY ECKERT. MY HUSBAND WAS KILLED DURING THE 9/11 ATTACKS. THEFREETHOUGHTPROJECT.COM. I REJECTED $1.8 MILLION FROM THE GOVERNMENT AND FILED A LAWSUIT AGAINST THEM INSTEAD. I WAS A LOUD MOUTH & A WELL KNOWN FIGURE IN THE 9/11 TRUTH MOVEMENT. COINCIDENTALLY, DAYS AFTER MEETING PRESIDENT OBAMA, I DIED IN A PLANE CRASH.
flags: Meme insinuates Eckert's 2009 Colgan Air Flight 3407 death was connected to meeting Obama — an unsupported conspiracy claim
Characterization of Eckert as a "9/11 truth movement" figure is the meme's claim; she was known as an advocate for the 9/11 Commission
Husband pictured in held photo is Sean Rooney per historical context, not named in the image
